note: mechanical operationalizations applied where the prereg leaves an implementation degree of freedom; no threshold was changed

items.P_denominator: sqrt(v_t)+eps computed once per checkpoint elementwise; eps read from the checkpoint optimizer param_groups (1e-15); SH group eps applies to sh_dc and sh_rest
items.score: two full passes in fp64: pass1 mean_v P(g_v); pass2 sum_i (P(g_i)-mean)^2; score_j = (sum over d)/(64); stable descending argsort (ties by row index)
items.cbar: FP32 exact mean of the stored FP16 values (fp64 accumulation then fp32 cast); estimator subtracts exactly the stored FP16 c_i (cast fp32) and adds c_bar
items.median_gain_beyond_noise: median_a(delta_b2 - delta_b1) > max over the noise subset anchors of (max-min) of the three B1 DeltaHeldoutLoss repeats
items.no_catastrophic_group_instability: params finite after every step in all anchors AND for every group the median ||dtheta||_B2 <= 3.0x the median ||dtheta||_B1
items.anchors_and_eval: anchors_32 = quantile(64->32) of the frozen camera list (odd positions); internal_eval_16 = quantile (32->16) of the remaining even positions; disjoint; frozen in MG0_CAMERA_SET.json before gradients
items.25K_stage: no new control store at 25K (no 30K consumer exists); the 25K hot ranking is recorded for completeness only
items.cost_probe: isolated op sequence as in prereg §7; control source per checkpoint: 15K->15K, 20K->15K, 25K->20K; normalized vs N1_ACTION_TIMING_{scene}.json '{ckpt}_A1' total_wall_ms.median
items.estimator_arithmetic: v = (g - c_i) + c_bar evaluated left-to-right in fp32 exactly as the isolated ops implement it
